summary: Backend-only verification of the new International IVR rate policy ($0.50/min intl, $0.15/min US/CA) plus regressions (Widen Reconciler, Call Reconciler, Bulk Transfer Parity, health). All 6 required endpoints returned HTTP 200 with pass===true and every assertion (rates, checks, expectedCharge/observedCharge, reconciler summary counts) matched the spec exactly.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/js/_index.js is very large; dev test endpoints (billing/reconciler) could be extracted into a dedicated module for maintainability.

getIvrCallRate uses isUSCanada(dest) — ensure destination normalization is consistent (E.164) at all call sites (initiateOutboundIvrCall pre-flight, mid-call timer, billCallMinutesUnified) to avoid rate mismatch on unnormalized inputs.
seed_data_creation: Each dev endpoint self-seeds synthetic fixtures (fake chatIds, unique callRefs) and cleans up; no production wallet touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test file /app/backend/tests/test_ivr_intl_rate_policy.py covers: /api/health, /api/dev/ivr-rate-policy-test (rates: ivr/sip intl=0.5, usca=0.15), /api/dev/twilio-ivr-transfer-billing-test (expectedCharge=observedCharge=1, all 8 checks true incl usca_charged_flat_ivr_rate), /api/dev/bulk-transfer-billing-test (expectedCharge=1, 6 checks), /api/dev/reconciler-widen-test (scanned=3, reconciledByWebhook=2, needsReview>=1, settled=0, dryRun=true), /api/dev/call-reconciler-test.
